thesis: Todd McKinnon left his role as an engineer at Salesforce in 2008 to start Octa because he believed the entire technology stack, including infrastructure and collaboration apps, would shift to the cloud. He originally intended to build a monitoring system for other cloud applications to help IT teams ensure all their systems were up and running during this transition.
